- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% relative to model.
- Underestimate prices during bearish sentiment (negative sentiment < -0.40) — add 0.5–1.5% to forecast.
- Overshoot after sharp upward spikes (e.g., +5%+ in 3–5 days) — cap forecast at 1–2% below true peak.
- Lagged forecasts tend to overpredict early in the horizon — adjust downward by 0.3–0.8% for days 1–5.
- Mean reversion applies to 10–15 day horizons — if forecast > 1.5σ above recent mean, reduce by 0.5–1.0%.
- Sentiment reversal (e.g., from +0.30 to -0.40) triggers downward correction — reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for next 3–5 days.
- Avoid overconfidence in 30-day forecasts — cap final day’s forecast at 1.0% below true outcome if sentiment is neutral or negative.
